appShell.placeholder: The last known local data is shown. Detailed workspaces will be available in later features.

bootstrap.recoveryDescription: An unfinished recovery operation needs attention. SkillHub will not show potentially stale local data until recovery is complete.
bootstrap.recoveryInProgressDescription: SkillHub is restoring local data. Potentially stale local data will remain hidden until restoration is complete.

onboarding.compatibilityConfirmation: I understand this only discovers agents and will not deploy skills
onboarding.compatibilityDescription: Discovery only creates compatibility information. Deployment requires a separate preview and confirmation later.
onboarding.contractUnavailable: This action is not yet connected to the native service. No directory, deployment, or import was made.
onboarding.libraryDescription: The library keeps managed skill content in one place. An empty directory is created only after confirmation.
onboarding.libraryHelper: To use another location, change it through a path picker once the native service is connected.
onboarding.scanDescription: The scan only creates a preview. It will not move, import, or deploy skills.
onboarding.scanFailed: The scan could not be completed. Existing skills and directories were not changed.
onboarding.skipDescription: An empty library will be created at {{path}}. No agents will be discovered and no skills will be scanned, imported, or deployed.
